description: This file declares the LifecycleManagerImplementation class, which implements multiple interfaces related to application lifecycle management, state management, configuration, and event handling within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal data members for managing application lifecycle events and notifications.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements lifecycle management, state management, configuration, and event handling for applications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. Manages notifications, application contexts, and dispatches lifecycle events.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within LifecycleManagerImplementation that represents a dispatchable job for handling lifecycle events asynchronously.

methods.name: ~LifecycleManagerImplementation
methods.description: Destructor for the class, handles cleanup.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification interface for lifecycle events.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loaded applications.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific app is loaded.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Sets the desired state for an application.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends an intent to the active application.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicates completion of a state change for an app.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes an application with a specified reason.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle manager with the provided service.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lifecycle manager with the given service.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the lifecycle manager.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Internal method to dispatch events based on type.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves application context based on instance ID and app ID.
